title: The client waited
transcript: Business onboarding brings together accounts, ACH, wires and entitlements. The work crosses systems, teams and controls.
Follow one onboarding request. A logistics company, setting up treasury services.

The relationship manager opens it. It moves through KYC, treasury ops and core banking. Then it comes back for more information, and the same form is keyed in again. At ACH limit approval, it waits six days in one queue.
Business day eleven. Entitlements are still pending.
Local reports show completed tasks and open work. End-to-end activation time is not shown.
Completed tasks. An unfinished customer journey.
The delay may sit between the steps. Separate records make the whole journey hard to see.
RE-ViVE connects the operational records your bank already keeps, and reconstructs how the request actually progressed.
See where time accumulated, and what remains open today. Investigate the approval queue. Confirm ownership of pending user setup. Source access stays read-only. Required checks remain in place.
Opening the relationship is one milestone. Getting the customer operating is another.
Request a banking walkthrough. See how one customer journey connects across systems, and how to trace where it waits.
